title: Population-Aligned Persona Generation for LLM-based Social Simulation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the distributions of LLM-generated survey responses to real-world global human data across multiple psychometric instruments (e.g., IPIP Big Five, CFCS, FBPS, Duckworth) using statistical distance metrics such as Averaged Monotonic Wasserstein (AMW), Fréchet Distance (FD), Sliced Wasserstein Distance (SW), and Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD).

Evaluating the demographic and cultural alignment of group-specific generated personas by comparing their simulated responses against regional subsets (East Asia, North America, Western Europe) of the World Values Survey (WVS) and the Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System (YRBSS) using distribution distance metrics.
